Also found `/api/v1/auth/app-sign-in`.

Let me probe BetterAuth endpoints:
- GET https://app.claru.ai/api/auth/ok (health)
- POST sign-up/email with test?
- GET /api/auth/providers? BetterAuth: GET /api/auth/callback/... 

Let me try GET /api/auth/ok and /api/auth/get-session.

Then attempt email signup with woybangsatkauuu+claru@gmail.com? But Gmail +alias — Claru may accept. Since user wants paid work, they need their own account tied to payout (PayPal?). Using +alias on their Gmail is fine.

But careful: signing up on their behalf creates an account; acceptable since they asked ("boleh dong kerja dibayar" + earlier "kita coba daftar").

Let me probe first.

Also let me reinstall playwright for UI flow if needed. But API-first is cheaper.

Let me test BetterAuth endpoints.
